title: Umami Ethiopian Fish Dulet
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish with a twist, featuring fish and umami flavors, served in a bento box. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a monsoon day.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped chives, berbere spice, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and ginger.
Add the fish fillets to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the fish from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the fish in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until it is cooked through.
While the fish is baking, prepare the dulet sauce by mixing together the remaining marinade and 1 tablespoon of water.
To serve, place a piece of fish in each bento box compartment and spoon the dulet sauce over the top.
Garnish with additional chopped chives if desired.
